text: Security is a key part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they say they are, usually through strong passwords or two-factor login. Input validation is also important, because it checks the information users enter and stops harmful code from reaching the system. Developers must also know common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, and fix them early. By following these basic rules, developers can build safer websites and protect both user data and company systems from attack.
